description: This file defines the Bestseller model class for the OpenCart admin module, handling database operations related to product bestsellers such as install, uninstall, update totals, retrieve reports, and delete entries.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: Model class for managing bestseller product data within the OpenCart admin module, providing methods to install/uninstall the relevant database table, update sales totals, delete records, and generate reports.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_bestseller' table in the database if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_bestseller' table from the database.

methods.name: editTotal
methods.description: Updates or inserts the total sales count for a specific product.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes the bestseller record for a specific product.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bestseller records ordered by total sales, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of bestseller records.
